sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface expression confirmed by anti-V5 immunofluorescence in non-permeabilized COS cells; no ligand-binding or signalling functional assay reported in this clip.
sites.rationale: OLR1/LOX-1 is a Type II transmembrane protein with its entire C-terminal domain (residues 58–273) extracellular. The pEF/V5-His vector places the V5 tag at the protein C-terminus, which is therefore extracellular and surface-accessible. L1 directly demonstrates surface display by anti-V5 staining of intact, non-permeabilized cells, making this the highest-confidence extracellular junction. Python confirms residue 273 is Q and lies 216 residues from the TM boundary, well clear of any TM constraint. No residue number for the tag junction is stated in the paper, so position_evidence is topology_derived rather than validated. Full-length human LOX-1 subcloned into pEF/V5-His (C-terminal V5-His) and expressed in COS cells; anti-V5 antibody staining of non-permeabilized cells confirmed surface display of the tagged receptor. OLR1 is a Type II single-pass TM protein (N-terminus intracellular, residues 1–36; TM 37–57; extracellular domain 58–273), so the C-terminal V5-His tag is the sole extracellular terminus. No residue number is given for the tag junction in the paper; the position is derived from the topology landmarks.

sources.claim: Surface expressed K/K167-V5, N/N167-V5 or LOXIN-V5 proteins were visualized with Mab anti-V5 (panels a, d and g respectively).

Individual clonal populations were isolated and propagated to assay for tetracycline (1 μg/ml) inducible LOX-1-FLAG expression, detected by immunoblotting with mouse anti-FLAG M2 monoclonal antibody (Merck).

literature_notes: All four ledger lines (L1–L4) converge on C-terminal tagging of full-length LOX-1. L1, L2, and L3 are from the same paper (PMC2645694) and describe the same pEF/V5-His C-terminal construct; L1 is the strongest (surface staining in non-permeabilized cells) and is used as the primary support for site 1. L4 (PMC10641530) independently reports a C-terminal FLAG tag and is used for site 2. The 'K167' and 'N167' labels in L1/L3 refer to the K167N point mutation in the CTLD domain, not to the tag insertion position; residue 167 (K) is extracellular but no tag insertion at that residue is reported in the ledger. No internal loop insertions are supported by the ledger. The N-terminus (residues 1–36) is intracellular, so no N-terminal extracellular site exists for this Type II TM protein.
